# bytemancy 1

## 題目描述 (Description)

Can you conjure the right bytes? The program's source code can be downloaded [here](https://challenge-files.picoctf.net/c_foggy_cliff/b04a1829da5f649435a6903647d126ba60a3d04a250e8f7e3973b2ce121beba5/app.py).

### 提示 (Hints)

1. Hint 1  
    No copy-pasta, please - use Python!

## 解題思路 (Solution Walkthrough)

1. **第一步**：可以看到 app.py 裡面說要 1751 個 `\x65` 才會給 flag，於是寫了一個腳本，複製結果然後輸入即可取得 flag

    ```text
    ⊹──────[ BYTEMANCY-1 ]──────⊹
    ☍⟐☉⟊☽☈⟁⧋⟡☍⟐☉⟊☽☈⟁⧋⟡☍⟐☉⟊☽☈⟁⧋⟡☍⟐

    Send me ASCII DECIMAL 101 1751 times, side-by-side, no space.

    ☍⟐☉⟊☽☈⟁⧋⟡☍⟐☉⟊☽☈⟁⧋⟡☍⟐☉⟊☽☈⟁⧋⟡☍⟐
    ⊹─────────────⟡─────────────⊹
    ==> 
    picoCTF{h0w_m4ny_e's???_be9356c0}
    ```

## Flag

```text
picoCTF{h0w_m4ny_e's???_be9356c0}
```
